settingLabels.search.llm.enabled.name: LLM-augmented search — enabled
settingLabels.search.llm.enabled.descrip: When on, Meilisearch runs hybrid lexical + semantic search using the configured embedder. It can be switched on only when the embedder credentials setting below references an LLM credential that supplies a Base URL, API key and model.
settingLabels.search.llm.embedder_creden: Reference a reusable LLM credential configuration (Credentials screen). Its Base URL, API Key and Model provide the embedder endpoint, credential and model. Required to enable LLM-augmented search.
